source: represent progressively broader information. At query time it can retrieve across levels, which was designed to help questions that require holistic or multi-step understanding rather than one local span. The trade-off is extra indexing cost and possible summary error: an abstractive parent node is itself model-generated and can omit or distort detail. A common production pattern is therefore to use higher-level nodes to navigate or broaden recall but retain links to original source passages for evidence and citation. Hierarchy is valuable when document structure or question scope demands it; it is unnecessary complexity for small corpora dominated by local fact lookup. [7]
zh: 代表越来越广泛的信息。在查询时，它可以跨级别检索，旨在帮助需要整体或多步骤理解而不是局部跨度的问题。权衡是额外的索引成本和可能的摘要错误：抽象父节点本身是模型生成的，可以省略或扭曲细节。因此，常见的生产模式是使用更高级别的节点来导航或扩大回忆，但保留原始源段落的链接以供证据和引用。当文档结构或问题范围需要时，层次结构很有价值；对于以局部事实查找为主的小型语料库来说，这是不必要的复杂性。 [7]
